subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add an opt-in mode to ingest every Space message, and should that mode use Workspace Events/Pub/Sub, user OAuth, app authentication, or remain unsupported?
rationale: The remaining request changes what Space content reaches OpenClaw, which Google credentials and scopes are stored, and how subscriptions are provisioned, so automation should not choose the privacy/security boundary.

options.title: Design Opt-In Workspace Events Mode
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a Google Chat plugin design covering scopes, subscription lifecycle, consent, allowlists, docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

options.title: Defer All-Message Ingestion
options.body: Document Google Chat as @mention/webhook-only for now and revisit only if maintainers explicitly accept the broader visibility surface later.

options.title: Split Threading From Visibility
options.body: Review focused thread/session PRs separately while keeping all-message ingestion in this issue or a dedicated security design item.

recommendation.title: Design Opt-In Workspace Events Mode
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a Google Chat plugin design covering scopes, subscription lifecycle, consent, allowlists, docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current routing signal from Google Chat thread/API history and security-sensitive plugin-boundary review.
